researchEvidence.note: Official DLCP Board of Industrial Trades page reviewed; it states that the board governs asbestos workers, plumbers, electricians, refrigeration and air conditioning mechanics, steam engineers, elevator trades, and related trade contractors.

Official DOB permit page reviewed; it states that trade permits include A/C, electric, plumbing, and water or sewer excavation work and that only licensed DC contractors for the specific trade may apply.
Official SCOUT lookup retained as the broad public verification path, pending adapter review for Industrial Trades filters.
